description: This Java class models the <field-type> element in an XML configuration for the OFBiz entity framework. It encapsulates attributes such as name, loader, and location, and provides methods to access these attributes. The constructor initializes the object by parsing an XML element and throws exceptions if required attributes are missing or empty.

classes.name: FieldType
classes.description: A class representing a <field-type> configuration element in the entity framework, encapsulating its attributes and providing accessors.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the value of the name attribute.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Returns the value of the loader attribute.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the value of the location attribute.
